mapper.sql: id, user_id, parent_id, reply_to, username, content, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guestbook WHERE parent_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook (user_id, username, content, parent_id, reply_to) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyTo})
mapper.update: UPDATE guestbook SET content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM guestbook_agree WHERE message_id IN #{id} GROUP BY message_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM guestbook_agree WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND user_id = #{userId}
